tools.name: claim
tools.description: Claim a path before editing it, so parallel agent sessions do not overwrite each other. ok false names the session that holds it; then work on something else or wait. A claim lasts 24 hours; claim again to renew.

tools.name: who
tools.description: Which session holds a path, if any.

tools.name: release
tools.description: Release a path this session holds, when its edit is committed.
